$comment: Components allowed despite failing the licence allow-list. Each entry needs the exact component (group:name or name, optionally @version) and a reason; review at every release.

exceptions.reason: Font files (SIL OFL-1.1), bundled unmodified and served to browsers; not code linked into ours. OFL permits redistribution with software; obligation met by shipping the licence text at /licenses/ (web/public/licenses). Phase 1a E01.

POM metadata error, not a licence change: the 4.1.1 POMs name a 'Broadcom Foundation License' without text or URL, while the jar's META-INF/LICENSE.txt and every source header are Apache-2.0. Spring maintainers confirmed it as a release-tooling bug (spring-projects/spring-session#3910, fixed for 4.1.2). Remove when Boot manages Spring Session >= 4.1.2. Phase 1a E03.
